bullets.text: A two-foot-wide sinkhole on Velachery Main Road caused traffic disruption, and the office should monitor repair works.
Cyclonic storm Murasu has prompted an orange alert and heavy rain forecast for Chennai and Thiruvallur, requiring strict disaster vigilance.
All schools in Chennai and Thiruvallur remain closed due to heavy rain forecasts, and the office should track official updates.
Pelican birds resting on high-voltage transmission towers in Pallikaranai marshland are suffering fatal electrocutions, requiring preventive action from authorities.
An anti-drug marathon was held at Besant Nagar by the Federation of Tamil Nadu Traders Associations Youth Wing, promoting awareness.
The 22-kilometre Padi-Thiruninravur stretch faces severe traffic congestion as the six-lane widening proposal remains a non-starter.
Parents and students in Mambakkam Sathiram are anxious over a bush-filled panchayat union primary school campus plagued by venomous creatures.
Thousands of devotees waited three hours for darshan at the Thiruttani Murugan temple, and crowd management should be monitored.
L&T's Vyoma.AI has begun construction of a 52 MW AI data centre in Chennai, establishing the city as a digital hub.
The Greater Chennai Corporation launched a mobile kidney screening and dialysis vehicle funded by Mobis India through CSR.
The Global Startup Summit 2026 is scheduled for November 14 at Holiday Inn Chennai OMR IT Expressway to connect founders and investors.
